text_block_list.text: A shooting star streaks past Yodo in autumn—a new icon has been born, and the masses are whipped into a frenzy.
Praise! Praise! Henceforth, this solo will become a duo!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haah ha ha ha! This is it! Ayabe's very first battle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The thunderous voice of T.M. Opera O—one of Admire Vega's contemporaries and self-professed "Overlord"—resonates through the spectator stands.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Good friends, led by the star of destiny, we must witness this inaugural performance!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, but listen to me, Doto! Today should be the day that Ayabe stands center stage!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I'm trusting you! Warn me if the spectacular brightness I unconsciously emit begins to drown out that other star's light!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I understand! I'll warn you if you get too… bright…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um… It's already happening!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haah ha ha! What a predicament!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ngh… But surely Ayabe will be able to look radiant too, right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I managed to come and watch. I was a little worried when I took the wrong train the seventh time…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto is another peer. She's timid, yet perseverant, and today her peculiar clumsiness seems to be in full force.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I was able to make it this far thanks to the two of you. Opera O and…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wha? Where did she go?
Wow! You've become a fan? My fan?

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yeah! When I saw you in the Tracen Academy's New Hope special, I was totally captivated!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan A
text_block_list.text: You looked so, so, sooo cool, Narita Top Road!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan B
text_block_list.text: You run with such force! I'll always be cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Thank you! I'm so happy to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: But I'm only in the middle of training for my debut race, so give me some time and…

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'll do my very best to live up to your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your support, everyone! I hope you'll continue to cheer me on.

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan A
text_block_list.text: Woooow! She makes me feel so… alive!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan B
text_block_list.text: I love how direct she is! I think I would do anything for her!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Doto and Opera O! Sorry about that! I was just having a chat.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: W-wow, Top Road, you're as popular as ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Top Road—the new star of the generation that includes T.M. Opera O, Meisho Doto, and Admire Vega.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She, too, is here to observe Admire Vega's debut.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Oh! They're entering the paddock soon. I wonder if Ayabe is feeling ready.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Let's make sure she hears our support, right, guys?

text_block_list.name: Opera O and Doto
text_block_list.text: Indubitably! Y-yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell Admire Vega about the enthusiastic three rooting for her in the stands.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I figured the news might ease her nerves, but maybe I had no reason to be concerned. Admire Vega is present and solemnly prepared.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, almost subconsciously, I look down at her feet…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's fine.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Um.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'll let you know if I have any issues. You don't have to keep asking each time.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I won't be able to reciprocate either way.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm saying that I won't give you the response you want.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Don't think I'm trying to be unpleasant either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I unconsciously chuckle. After all of that, at the very least, I got an answer to my question—she's doing fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not looking for her to be friendly with me. I already decided to support her regardless.
choice_data_list: Keep your eyes forward while you're running.
Keep your eyes forward while you're running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not asking for her attention or consideration. No matter how she relates to me…
choice_data_list: I'll follow you down whichever path you take.
I'll follow you down whichever path you take.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Okay.

text_block_list.name: Official
text_block_list.text: It's time! Will all the debuting racers make their way to the paddock, please?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: All right.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The up-and-coming Umamusume making their debuts today are finally in the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Which of our racers will steal the victory here at Kyoto Racecourse?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Yeah… I know. I'm shaking.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (The part of you left in me is shaking with joy and anticipation.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …I'm going to win.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I promise, I'll win!
